identification: Large iridescent (blue/purple/green carnival-style) studio glass bowl with sandblasted/etched frieze of running animals and geometric borders, about 33 cm. Scratched signature on the base reads 'Dru Malone 2007' (reading confirmed on photo 3). Maker not found online.
